sleep_tight.configuration.misc.respawn_l: Makes players respawn by laying on their bed
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.fix_bed_p: Fixes multiplayer players being positioned 2 pixels above a bed
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.lay_when_: Allows laying on a bed when you are on sleeping cooldown
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.queen_siz: Allows player to sleep in the middle of two beds
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.behavior_: Disables damage from bed explosion when used in another dimension. Can also be used to disable explosion entirely allowing one to sleep in those dimensions
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.sleep_int: Interval between two consecutive sleep times for them to not be considered consecutive
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.boring_ni: Makes night bag less unique by allowing you to place them normally on the ground
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.sleep_imm: Immediately attempt sleeping after laying down on a bed
sleep_tight.configuration.heartstone_mod: Gives some benefit when sleeping next to somebody else. By default only works in conjunction with heartstone mod
Effect to give to players when they wake up
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.enable: Turns off bedbug spawning entirely. Bedbugs will still exist as a mob and can be spawned with eggs
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.spawn_: Base spawn chance every time you wake up, increases with difficulty
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.max_sp: max radius at which they can spawn
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.min_sp: min radius from which they can spawn
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.max_al: Max light level that a bedbug can spawn at
The game will perform x attempts to spawn a bedbug around each player when they wake up. This already takes into account the chance config.High values will decrease failed attempts
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.preven: Prevents bedbugs when using dream essence
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.only_w: Only spawns bedbugs when sleeping in your home bed
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.mansio: Chance for each bed generated in a woodland mansion to start out infested with a bedbug. Set to 0 to disable
sleep_tight.configuration.bedbugs.ambien: Enables phantom-style ambient bedbug spawning while awake (requires consistent recent sleep, opposite of phantoms)
Consecutive nights slept before ambient bedbugs can appear (phantoms use ~3 nights without sleep)
Min spawn distance from the player for ambient bedbugs. Note that natural spawn rules still forbid spawning within 24 blocks of any player, so values below that have no effect
Max spawn distance from the player for ambient bedbugs
sleep_tight.configuration.sleep_cooldown: Time before you can sleep/rest again after you've slept in a hammock
Time before you can sleep/rest again after you've successfully slept in a bed
Time before you can sleep/rest again after you've successfully slept in a bed
sleep_tight.configuration.sleep_benefits: Which type of beds will apply benefits on wake up
Effects to apply when player wakes up. You can add more entries, this is a list
sleep_tight.configuration.sleep_penaltie: Applies a cost, like hunger loss, every time you sleep
Method to calculate hunger loss. Can be based off time slept, difficulty or constant
Base hunger decrement value. Depends on other config. Set to 0 to disable
sleep_tight.configuration.sleep_requirem: Conditions that must be met before you are allowed to sleep
Requires player to have full hunger bar before being able to sleep
Xp cost for sleeping. Does not affect peaceful
sleep_tight.configuration.home_bed.home_: Amount of nights needed to make a home bed start increasing levels. Set to -1 to effectively disable home bed leveling
sleep_tight.configuration.home_bed.invig: Percentage of xp added per tier of the effect. Setting to 1 doubles the effect
sleep_tight.configuration.home_bed.max_l: Home bed level cap. Each night slept increases this number
sleep_tight.configuration.home_bed.only_: Makes respawning only possible when using your own Home Bed. Fight back the night!
sleep_tight.configuration.nightmares.ena: Sleeping too many nights in a row can end in a nightmare, waking you up early
sleep_tight.configuration.nightmares.app: Amount of consecutive nights slept after which nightmares could start to happen
sleep_tight.configuration.nightmares.sle: Multiplier applied to time slept after a nightmare
sleep_tight.configuration.nightmares.ins: Refractory period after a nightmare in which you won't be able to sleep
sleep_tight.configuration.nightmares.spe: Chance multiplier to have a nightmare when sleeping in a special bed. A 'special bed' is simply any (likely modded) bed that cant be targeted by a villager and or bedbug. Increased chance since you would be skipping bedbugs encounter otherwise
sleep_tight.configuration.wake_up_encoun: Sleeping in an exposed spot can wake you up to a mob that spawned next to you
The game will perform x attempts to spawn a mod around each player every time they sleep.Increases likelihood of finding one. Note that actual value will also depend on local difficulty
Max amount of mobs per encounter

Mobs that can randomly wake up the player if sleeping in a dark place. Leave empty to use default spawning behavior. Add a weighted list in the following format (replace line bellow with this example.This is a Toml map btw, check out its syntax):
[[wake_up_encounters.alternative_whitelist]]
			data = "minecraft:vindicator"
			weight = 2
[[wake_up_encounters.alternative_whitelist]]
			data = "minecraft:creeper"
			weight = 2
Multiplier applied to time slept after an encounter
Refractory period after an encounter in which you won't be able to sleep
sleep_tight.configuration.hammock.swing_: Intensity of velocity increment that is applied when controlling a hammock
sleep_tight.configuration.hammock.camera: Camera roll intensity when swinging on a hammock. Set to 0 to turn it off entirely
sleep_tight.configuration.hammock.hammoc: Swinging too much on a hammock will make you fall. Disable to do a barrel roll
How subtle the effect will be essentially. Set to one for bring fancy particles
Affects the plume height. lower to make the plume shorter
Makes particles spawn more often. Set to 0 to disable
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.show_inso: Show insomnia missing time when laying on a bed
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.crossair_: Show insomnia cooldown as a small bed icon above crossair when aiming at a bed or in one
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.show_time: Displays current time when sleeping. WITH_CLOCK only shows it while a clock is in the inventory
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.24h_time_: Shows the sleep time in 24h format instead of AM/PM
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.sleeping_: Makes villagers close their eyes when sleeping
sleep_tight.configuration.misc.zzz_parti: Spawn particles when sleeping. Set to 0 to disable
